name: wtf
description: Copyable professional person briefs; optional full profiles in your named template and save folder, with a sourced photo. Uses a LinkedIn connections export already available in the workspace to check direct connections and possible introductions; otherwise explicitly skips that check.

interface.longDescription: Copyable professional person briefs; optional full profiles in your named template and save folder, with a sourced photo. Uses a LinkedIn connections export already available in the workspace to check direct connections and possible introductions; otherwise explicitly skips that check. Candidate templates: Markdown, HTML, DOCX, PPTX, Google Docs and Slides, subject to available editing tools. PDFs are layout references; PDF output requires an exporter. No data service or paid subscription is bundled. No messages are sent. Live end-to-end behavior remains unvalidated.
